architecture.placement: Inside same Mongo transaction, after CloseoutCriticalReader fresh SalesOrder/ReturnOrder load, before per-order writers.
architecture.rawRead: One ArLedger.find over union of allowed canonical order lookup keys.
architecture.canonicalRead: One active canonical debt-read-model ArLedger.find over same union; sequential on same session.
architecture.partition: aliasOwner + canonicalOrderKey map; customer scope is an additional filter, never the partition key.
architecture.postAllocationMerge: Because Q11-Q13 AR rows are posted after batch preload, allocationResult.arLedgers are validated and merged into each order context before debt reconcile. No extra DB read.
architecture.formulaParity: currentArBalance uses normalizeAccountingAmount() exactly like prior getCurrentOrderArBalanceDetails().

bounds.note: 60-order/typical closeout fits one raw + one canonical query; no bounded chunking was required in this gate.
